title: The Car Resequencing Problem with Makespan Minimization
summary: Problem definition: The car resequencing problem involves rearranging the sequence of cars between two adjacent production shops via an intermediate buffer. This study explores a new variant that aims to minimize the resequencing makespan when the buffer features several forward lanes and a return lane (RL). Both types of lanes follow first-in-first-out rules, but operate in opposite directions. Through the RL, cars can circulate between forward lanes, thereby increasing resequencing flexibility and complexity.
